scope: Public manufacturer and seller purchase-price observations, including labeled secondary-market references. USD display uses dated reference FX while retaining native amounts. Catalog new condition is an inference when not explicit; stock and lead time require confirmation. University supplier relationships are procurement context, not endorsement or SKU-purchase proof.

institutional_context.finding: MIT recommends vetted preferred suppliers and identifies its VWR stockroom. Negotiated prices are accessed through its purchasing system.
